setting.note: Saleem Sinai, born on the stroke of India's independence, tells his life and the nation's together, from a Kashmir lake in 1915 through his Bombay childhood on Warden Road to the ghettos of Old Delhi and the swamps of the 1971 war. The anchor is Bombay; the story reaches the length of the subcontinent.
